mechanism: Ondansetron has weak serotonergic activity and phenelzine is a non-selective MAOI, creating risk for serotonin syndrome when combined.
action: Avoid this combination; if ondansetron is necessary for severe nausea/vomiting despite MAOI therapy, use alternative antiemetics (metoclopramide, prochlorperazine) or consider MAOI discontinuation with appropriate washout.
